findings.summary: Source workpool contract is not backed by durable sourceProcessingJobs claims/CAS.
findings.details: S06-T01 was a fixture-to-real swap from the demo workpool to @convex-dev/workpool plus sourceProcessingJobs leases/CAS. The changed registered functions only enqueue the background action and leave backgroundWork/onComplete as null handlers; all claim/heartbeat/complete/fail behavior exists as pure helpers and tests, not as durable Convex mutations against sourceProcessingJobs. This misses the accepted-effect, crash, receipt, and rollback-by-expiry contract.

findings.details: LeaseLost, RetryableJobFailure, PermanentJobFailure, MaxAttemptsReached, StaleGeneration, and DuplicateEffect are defined only for local reducer helpers.
